action.objective: Broad-search all legal White moves at depth 4 to identify tactical resources and king-safety issues after Black's Rc3.
action.rationale: First call requires full root coverage. Position is materially balanced (White R+B+4P vs Black 2R+B+3P with passed e-pawn). Need to check for tactics against White king (Rc2/c3 rooks, Bd8 bishop eyeing h4/b6) and find active resources like e6e7, Rf8+ ideas, or Be5-f6.
